units.source_text: 到了正月底，二女公子产期临近，身体不适。

en.t: By the end of the first month, the Second Princess was nearing her time to give birth and was feeling unwell.

units.source_text: 匂亲王不曾见过这种状态，看了非常着急，不知如何是好。

en.t: Prince Niou had never seen her in such a state, and he grew terribly anxious, not knowing what to do.

units.source_text: 安产祈祷早已在许多寺院内举行，此时又开始增添了几处。

en.t: Prayers for a safe delivery had already been held at many temples, and now several more places were added.

units.source_text: 二女公子身上非常痛苦，因此明石皇后也派人来慰问。

en.t: The Second Princess was suffering greatly, so Empress Akashi also sent someone to inquire after her.

units.source_text: 二女公子同匂亲王结婚，至今已有三年。

en.t: It had now been three years since the Second Princess married Prince Niou.

units.source_text: 其间只有匂亲王一人真心宠爱她，世间一般人对她都不重视。

en.t: During that time, only Prince Niou had truly cherished her, while people in general had paid her little regard.

units.source_text: 现在闻知明石皇后也来慰问，大家吃惊，各方面都来探望。

en.t: Now that people heard Empress Akashi had also sent inquiries, everyone was surprised, and visitors came from all sides to see her.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言的担心不亚于匂亲王，常常忧愁叹息，计虑后果如何。

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, was no less worried than Prince Niou, and he often sighed in distress as he pondered what might happen.

units.source_text: 但也只能做适度的问候，未便过分亲昵地表示关怀。

en.t: Yet he could only send measured inquiries and could not openly show concern in an overly intimate way.

units.source_text: 他偷偷地替二女公子举办安产祈祷。

en.t: In secret, he arranged prayers for the Second Princess to have a safe delivery.
